Current state: 5 of 17 themes eligible; Banks lead with high breadth (0.846) but mean-revert Hurst and crowded (z=1.15); Energy is the challenger; China Tech/Platform Megacaps are ranked last and below trend (ineligible) but are the only scorable themes.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Energy (H-shares) confirms a handoff from Banks: Banks has higher rank but mean-revert Hurst and crowded z=1.15, while Energy is trend-tagged, uncrowded, and the challenger with margin 0.215. theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: Both scorable China tech themes rank last (score -0.89), are below their absolute-trend eligibility gate (ineligible), and share the same proxy (3033.HK). On a market where the one validated edge is the trend gate, an ineligible theme with the weakest rank offers no trend-following reason to be present — avoiding it is the natural expression of the only validated discipline.
theses.dissent: China platform megacaps have been the market's dominant liquidity and beta theme for years; a sharp policy or flow reversal could snap them back faster than the trend gate reacts.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK clears its 50-day average and ranks above the eligibility threshold before day 20.

evidence: hurst_tag trend but breadth 0.833 vs score 0.68
